FATIMA RAHMAN
Senior Product Manager | B2B SaaS, platform migration, growth, partnerships

ShiftWorks — Senior Product Manager (2021–present)
• Led legacy-to-cloud migration strategy for 1,200 customer accounts.
• Increased activation by 36% through guided setup, integration readiness, and implementation-partner support.
• Launched a certified partner marketplace pilot that cut time-to-value for complex customers.
• Owned cross-functional roadmap across onboarding, billing, and partner products.

Earlier roles: Product Manager, Customer Operations Lead.
